# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Failed-flush cache fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 clears stale Ganesh cache entries when a GPU flush fails.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed GPU flushes clear stale cache entries** — Updates the bundled renderer so later Ganesh work does not reuse cache entries left stale after a failed flush. ([#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))
